messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"chapter":16,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"verse":71,"chapter":16,"text":"They will be like mad men, sparing none, but spoiling and destroying those who still fear the Lord."},{"verse":72,"chapter":16,"text":"For they will destroy and plunder their goods, and throw them out of their houses."},{"verse":73,"chapter":16,"text":"Then the trial of my elect will be made known, even as the gold that is tried in the fire."},{"verse":74,"chapter":16,"text":"Hear, my elect ones, says the Lord: “Behold, the days of suffering are at hand, and I will deliver you from them."},{"verse":75,"chapter":16,"text":"Don’t be afraid, and don’t doubt, for God is your guide."},{"verse":76,"chapter":16,"text":"You who keep my commandments and precepts,” says the Lord God, “don’t let your sins weigh you down, and don’t let your iniquities lift themselves up.”"},{"verse":77,"chapter":16,"text":"Woe to those who are choked with their sins and covered with their iniquities, like a field is choked with bushes, and its path covered with thorns, that no one may travel through!"},{"verse":78,"chapter":16,"text":"It is shut off and given up to be consumed by fire."}]}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 71,72,73,74,75,76,77,78 in this chapter.
